jobs.title: 3D Computer Vision Researcher – Arlington, VA
jobs.description_text: Advance 3D Vision Research from Algorithms to Open Source Applications. In this position, you’ll research and develop algorithms for photogrammetry, camera calibration, registration, and 3D reconstruction from images and video. Current projects emphasize aerial and satellite imagery, with opportunities to adapt these capabilities to new challenges and data domains such as underwater imagery and synthetic aperture radar. Your work will contribute to open source applications and frameworks including TeleSculptor, KWIVER, and Danesfield. You’ll also explore how 3D vision can support broader computer vision problems such as object detection and tracking, change detection, super resolution, and video compression. Kitware partners with government R&D agencies, branches of the U.S. military, members of the Intelligence Community, and commercial organizations ranging from startups to Fortune 500 companies. You’ll have opportunities to collaborate directly with customers, participate in field tests and demonstrations, publish novel work, and apply state-of-the-art artificial intelligence approaches to real-world national security challenges.

Kitware advances science and makes the world a better place through open-source software. We collaborate with top universities, national laboratories, government agencies, and commercial technology leaders to develop both cutting-edge research prototypes and production systems with outsized real-world impact. We're building software that will matter for decades. jobs.title: Associate Director, Capital Markets Finance
jobs.description_text: Role Summary We are seeking a motivated Associate Director, Capital Markets Finance, preferably with a background in investment banking or equity research, to help build on and execute our capital markets strategy. Reporting to the CFO, this role will support existing relationships with analysts and investors, while also serving as a trusted resource to senior leadership on how Wall Street views our strategy, pipeline, and financial performance. The successful candidate thrives at the intersection of finance, science, and storytelling, translating complex clinical and operational data into compelling investor-ready narratives that resonate with institutional investors and analysts.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Marketing
jobs.description_text: Role Summary Lexeo’s Commercial team is building the strategy, insights, brand and infrastructure required to bring LX2006 to patients – marking Lexeo’s transition from a clinical-stage to a commercial company. We are seeking an Associate Director, Marketing to play a central role in preparing for the launch of LX2006, Lexeo’s first commercial product, anticipated in the US in 2028 and globally thereafter. Reporting to the Senior Director, Marketing, this individual will serve as the LX2006 brand lead, owning critical launch workstreams end to end – from customer insights and competitive intelligence to market development, campaigns, customer targeting and launch readiness – and working closely with cross-functional partners in Market Access/HEOR, Medical Affairs, Patient Affairs, Clinical Development, Regulatory, Legal, CMC, and Business Development (ad hoc) as part of Lexeo’s Launch Readiness Team. The role will also support early commercial planning for LX2020, Lexeo’s gene therapy candidate for PKP2-associated arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy. This is a highly visible, hands-on opportunity to build a launch from the ground up and help shape the commercial foundation of a growing clinical stage company.

jobs.title: Manager/Senior Manager, Clinical Innovation and Corporate Communications
jobs.description_text: Role Summary Lexeo is seeking a Manager or Senior Manager, Clinical Innovation and Corporate Communications, to help advance our clinical trial innovation strategy, develop clinically-oriented corporate communications across our pipeline, and support broader corporate strategy and commercial development projects. This highly cross-functional role will evaluate new geographies, trial models, and other approaches that could improve the speed, efficiency, and execution of clinical development across Lexeo’s portfolio. The individual will also translate complex clinical, scientific, and regulatory information into clear, compelling communications for patients, healthcare professionals, media, investors, and other external audiences. This role will sit within the Clinical organization and partner closely with Medical Affairs, Patient Affairs, Investor Relations, and other functions. A successful candidate will combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution and will have the opportunity to shape high-priority initiatives across clinical development, communications, and corporate strategy.

jobs.title: Scientist I/II, In Vivo Pharmacology
jobs.description_text: Role Summary Lexeo is seeking a hands-on in vivo pharmacologist to build rodent models of cardiac disease and use them to de-risk targets, screen therapeutic candidates and advance our discovery pipeline. The scientist will design, perform or manage rodent studies from target validation through hit identification, working cross-functionally with In Vitro Pharmacology, Modality Engineering, and Translational Sciences to select-advance molecules. Reporting to the Head of Cardiac Research, this role joins cardiac, neuroscience, and non-clinical scientists developing therapies for genetic heart disease and offers broad experience in multidisciplinary biopharma research.

jobs.title: Scientist I/II, Modality Engineering
jobs.description_text: Role Summary Lexeo is hiring a hands-on Modality Engineering Scientist to design, synthesize, and characterize oligonucleotides, bioconjugates, and AAV therapeutics for our discovery pipeline. The scientist will advance molecules from design through analytical characterization and handoff to in vitro and in vivo teams, working across chemistry, molecular biology, and pharmacology. Reporting to the Head of Cardiac Research, this role joins cardiac, neuroscience, and non-clinical scientists developing therapies for genetic heart disease and offers broad experience in multidisciplinary biopharma research.

jobs.title: Scientist II, Cellular Neuroscience and Translational Pharmacology
jobs.description_text: Role Summary We are seeking a highly collaborative, hands-on Scientist II to help establish a preclinical neuroscience laboratory supporting small-molecule and protein therapeutics. The immediate priorities are rapid cellular profiling and lead selection for an advanced small-molecule enzyme program, and leadership of cellular development for a transferrin-based protein replacement project. The role will also build fit-for-purpose human neuronal models, laboratory workflows, and external partnerships. Location We welcome applications from candidates located across the Northeast and Mid-Atlantic.

jobs.title: Senior Optical Design Engineer
jobs.description_text: Overview We are expanding our optomechanical capabilities, and the success of our projects depends on optical designs that are precise, manufacturable, and verified through rigorous analysis and testing. As a Senior Optical Design Engineer, you will own optical designs from concept through lab validation, turning requirements into lens designs and optical assemblies that perform reliably in the real world. This position is central to our mission of delivering cutting-edge free-space optical systems for space applications, and it will support successful pre-production runs and strong collaboration with our suppliers. This position reports to our Responsible Engineer, Optical Systems, and is based in our Toulouse, France office. Our working language is English.

jobs.title: Thermal Test and Modelling Engineer
jobs.description_text: What is the role: We are seeking a Thermal Engineer to own the thermal analysis and testing of our space products, such as sensors and actuators. The role centers on building thermal models and correlating them with test data, and on planning and running thermal test campaigns in house. It is a hands-on position: you will instrument and run tests yourself and use the results to improve both the design and our test infrastructure. This position is based in our Toulouse office.

jobs.title: Learning & Development (L&D) Project Manager
jobs.description_text: Please note: this is a 12-month contract position. LTA Research is seeking a Learning & Development Project Manager to drive execution of our learning and development priorities. Reporting to the Talent Management Lead, this role will manage LTA’s L&D projects and training operations, including LMS implementation, company-wide training coordination, and support for the Manager Efficacy Program. The initial focus will be leading execution of LTA’s company-wide L&D infrastructure work, including the training inventory, LMS evaluation and implementation, and company-wide rollout. The role will also coordinate ongoing L&D training and support the Manager Efficacy Program.

jobs.title: Recruiting Coordinator
jobs.description_text: Please note: this is a 12-month contract position with expectations to be Onsite 5 days/week. (exceptions to WFH occasionally upon manager approval) The Recruiting Coordinator supports the day-to-day execution of LTA’s recruiting process by coordinating interviews, managing candidate and hiring-manager logistics, maintaining recruiting data and documentation, and ensuring a consistent and professional candidate experience. The role partners closely with recruiters and hiring managers to keep recruiting activities organized, timely, and accurate.

jobs.title: Senior Environmental, Health, and Safety (EH&S) Engineer
jobs.description_text: Please note: this is a 24-month contract position. The Senior Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) Engineer will lead the development and ongoing management of EHS programs that keep employees safe and company operations in compliance across manufacturing and test activities. This position requires broad EHS experience in a manufacturing or R&D environment and the ability to work independently with engineering, operations, and regulatory agencies. The role is based in Akron, Ohio, with periodic travel to other company locations.

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer, Hydrogen (CA)
jobs.description_text: LTA Research builds and flies next-generation airships. Our proof-of-concept aircraft, Pathfinder 1, is the largest aircraft flying today, and we operate it as a working test platform to push airship technology forward: moving cargo and people to places without roads, runways, or ports, including disaster relief when infrastructure is cut off. Weight matters in every decision we make. This senior role owns mechanical, thermal, and fluid systems from concept through flight test, with a central part in developing the hydrogen propulsion system for our next aircraft. The base salary range for this role is $135,000 - 160,000, which is determined based on experience, geography, and qualifications. The base salary is one component of the total compensation package, which includes a very competitive annual bonus, 401K Match, and other generous benefits. While we believe competitive compensation is a critical aspect of your decision to join us, we do hope you also spend time considering why our mission and culture are right for you.

jobs.title: Corporate Counsel, Government Contracts
jobs.description_text: Long Wall Company was created in 2024 to accelerate missile defense technology for the U.S. and our allies. We specialize in ballistic missile defense and are developing Cyclops, a low-cost, mass-producible interceptor. We also produce containerized launchers and offer low-cost targets for threat replication. The future of global security depends on defensive technology that redefines cost, magazine depth, and distribution to deter and defend against evolving threats. Join us. WHAT WE LOOK FOR Mission-Driven Problem Solvers– The problems in missile defense demand ingenuity. We want engineers, technicians, and corporate professionals who approach challenges with curiosity, embrace failure as a learning opportunity, and stay focused on delivering the best solution for the mission. Total Ownership– We seek those who take full responsibility for delivering flight-ready work while recognizing that no one succeeds alone. The best engineers, technicians, and corporate professionals make their teammates better, knowing that complementary skills create force multiplication and drive mission success. The compensation range for this role is $200,000- $240,000/yr This is the lowest-to-highest compensation range we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. jobs.title: Director, Autonomous Systems
jobs.description_text: Director, Autonomous Systems DESCRIPTION Long Wall is seeking a Director of Autonomous Systems to lead the software, guidance, navigation, and control (GNC), autonomy, and simulation capabilities that underpin the Cyclops interceptor and RSX target vehicle programs. This leader will own the technical strategy and execution required to transform mission objectives into reliable, flight-ready systems. The role combines deep technical leadership with team building and cross-functional execution, spanning algorithms, modeling and simulation, embedded software, perception, autonomy, and vehicle-level integration. Successful candidates will know how to move quickly without compromising engineering rigor. They will guide system-level trades, establish scalable technical foundations, and help teams deliver exceptional performance using cost-effective, producible hardware. In hit-to-kill missile defense, every millisecond matters. This role offers the opportunity to build the team and technology responsible for making those milliseconds count. The compensation range for this role is $220,000 - $290,000/yr This is the lowest to highest compensation range we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting.

jobs.title: Internal Ballistician
jobs.description_text: Internal Ballistician DESCRIPTION Long Wall is seeking an experienced Ballistician to support the design, development, testing, and production of solid rocket motors (SRMs) for our interceptor system. This role is responsible for ensuring that SRM ballistic performance meets demanding missile-interception requirements while remaining manufacturable at scale. The Ballistician serves as the technical authority for SRM internal ballistics and overall booster performance. Responsibilities include developing and optimizing propellant grain designs; performing SRM performance analysis (including sensitivity to off-nominal conditions); reviewing and interpreting static-fire and flight-test data; providing technical oversight and direction to propulsion suppliers; and defining ballistic requirements and verifying compliance throughout development and production. The successful candidate will establish rigorous analytical methods while driving efficient program execution. They will work closely with propulsion, structures, aerodynamics, guidance and control, manufacturing, and systems engineering teams to ensure ballistic decisions remain aligned with system-level performance, technical baselines, and program objectives The compensation range for this role is $120,000 - $200,000/yr This is the lowest to highest compensation range we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting.

jobs.description_text: General Application DESCRIPTION We want to hear from you. Long Wall is growing quickly across engineering, manufacturing, test, and business operations, and new positions open regularly. This general application lets you share your background with our recruiting team so we can reach out when a role matches your skills and interests. We review general applications on a rolling basis and will contact you directly if there is a potential fit. When a specific posting matches your background, we encourage you to apply to that role as well. Note: Submitting here is not an application to a specific position and does not guarantee an interview.

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description_text: PROGRAM MANAGER DESCRIPTION Long Wall is seeking a motivated and technically capable Program Manager to support the execution and growth of programs serving the U.S. Department of War (DoW) and other customers. As a key interface between Long Wall and our customers, you will support program execution, customer engagement, and technical coordination, helping keep programs on schedule, on budget, and aligned with contractual requirements. You will work closely with Program Management leadership, engineering, contracts, and finance teams, government program offices, and industry partners, turning plans into schedules, tracking commitments through to closure, and ensuring customers receive clear, accurate information about program status. This is a hands-on role in a fast-moving environment and a direct path to building program management expertise. You will gain real experience with defense acquisition, from traditional contracting to newer, faster pathways such as Other Transaction (OT) agreements and rapid prototyping, along with government contracting and customer relationship management. The compensation range for this role is $109,998 - $155,000/yr This is the lowest to highest compensation range we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting.

jobs.description_text: Sr. Director, Manufacturing DESCRIPTION The Senior Director, Manufacturing will lead Long Wall’s manufacturing organization, ensuring the company can rapidly develop, build, test, and scale the next generation of missile defense systems. Operating in a highly integrated aerospace environment, you will be responsible for building the teams, capabilities, facilities, and operational systems required to support hardware programs from early development through production. This role provides leadership across both Manufacturing Operations and Manufacturing Engineering, ensuring new products are industrialized efficiently while maintaining world-class execution on cost, quality, schedule, and safety. The ideal candidate thrives in fast-paced, engineering-driven environments and has a proven track record of building high-performing teams, standing up new manufacturing capabilities, and delivering complex hardware under aggressive schedules. The compensation range for this role is $275,000 - $325,000/yr This is the lowest to highest compensation range we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting.

jobs.description_text: Staff Accountant, Corporate DESCRIPTION As a Staff Accountant on Long Wall’s Corporate Accounting team, you will support the daily accounting operations behind a fast-growing missile defense company. You will prepare journal entries, reconcile balance sheet accounts, maintain supporting schedules, and help deliver an accurate, timely month-end close. Your work keeps our financial records reliable and audit-ready as the company grows. This position reports to the Manager, Corporate Accounting. We are looking for a detail-oriented, curious accountant with a strong foundation in general accounting principles and a real interest in the craft. You are eager to learn, comfortable with change, and motivated to take on more responsibility in a fast-paced, evolving environment. The compensation range for this role is $75,000 - $110,000/yr This is the lowest to highest compensation range we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting.

jobs.title: Director, Defense Business Development – Europe & Middle East
jobs.description_text: Machina is looking for a Director of Defense Business Development – Europe & Middle East to establish and grow our presence with European defense primes, with the opportunity to expand into the Middle East over time. This is our first dedicated international business development role and will operate with significant autonomy. You’ll identify the programs and partners where Machina’s technologies and factories can have the greatest impact, build trusted relationships across European defense companies, and turn those relationships into technical engagements, proof-of-concept programs, qualification programs, and ultimately production opportunities, either fulfilled by Machina factories or deployed at customer sites. This is not a traditional sales role. This is a remote position based in Europe, with significant travel throughout the region and periodic travel to Machina’s headquarters in Los Angeles. Candidates must reside in Europe.

jobs.title: Manager, Program Operations
jobs.description_text: Make it rain. Make Snow. Make Earth Habitable. Rainmaker builds and deploys audacious technologies that work with nature to create an abundant, habitable planet. We are modernizing proven cloud-seeding science with weather-resistant UAS, radar and satellite observations, numerical weather prediction, novel sensing and validation systems, and sustainable seeding technologies. We are building an integrated system to make more freshwater available to farms, ecosystems, and communities. Our ambition is bold, but we pursue it with humility. We take on difficult problems in the real world with technical rigor, grit, integrity, and an openness to learning and course-correcting. We are hiring individuals with evidence of exceptional ability. If you want to build systems that endure, restore, and deliver the future we were promised, we want to hear from you. International Programs turns Rainmaker’s technology and customer commitments into operating programs in new markets. The team develops local operating capability and enduring community relationships while coordinating scientific, regulatory, and logistical requirements with Rainmaker’s specialist teams.

jobs.description_text: Role OverviewWe’re looking for a seasoned Staff Software Engineer who thrives on technical depth and broad influence. jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.description_text: Join the Future of Robotic Biomanufacturing! Multiply Labs is a robotics company on a mission to solve a significant bottleneck in modern medicine: the manufacturing of life-saving advanced biologics, from gene and cell therapies to antibodies and more. Today, these therapies are produced through manual, labor-intensive processes. Costs are extremely high—often $500K–$2M per patient—limiting access to only a small fraction of those who need them. As product complexity increases and the cost of failure and scientific labor rises, the industry is shifting toward automation. Robotics and AI are making automated biologics manufacturing feasible, reliable, and economically scalable. We believe the future of biomanufacturing is robotic—closed, automated, and scalable—ensuring critical therapeutics are accessible to every patient who needs them. Why This Matters We don’t just build robots—we’re building the essential infrastructure for next generation biologics. Our technology enables biopharma companies to scale production without redesigning their science, reducing regulatory hurdles and lowering costs so these treatments can reach more patients. The Stack & The Scale The Mission: Build the world’s best robots to make life-saving therapies accessible to all. The Technology: Advanced robotic orchestration, high-precision automation, cloud-integrated hardware-software systems, dextrous manipulation, and imitation learning. The Location: Headquartered in San Francisco, CA. The Backin

jobs.title: Electrical Design Automation Engineer
jobs.description_text: Please be prepared to share portfolio, Github, etc. in advance to the recruiter welcome call We are looking for an Electrical Design Automation Engineer to accelerate how Kepler designs, analyzes, and verify the electronics inside our satellites. You are an electrical engineer who understands the complete board-development lifecycle—from schematic capture and layout through bring-up, debugging, and verification. Along the way, you have likely found yourself writing scripts or building tools to eliminate repetitive work, improve consistency, and catch problems earlier. In this role you will own the Altium component library, develop automation, and then build and integrate scripted and AI-assisted tools across our electrical design and analysis workflows for years to come. This is a hands-on individual contributor role, working alongside our electrical, FPGA, RF, software, and test engineers where you will combine practical electrical engineering judgment with programming and automation to build tools that engineers can trust, maintain, and use over time.

jobs.title: Embedded Software Designer (Networking)
jobs.description_text: We're on the hunt for a top-tier Embedded Software Designer, who enjoys getting close to the hardware and wants to build the networking software that runs on it. You’ll work with network architects, FPGA developers, and fellow embedded software developers to build and debug networking features on embedded Linux, from customizing Yocto layers and working with memory-mapped peripherals to profiling memory usage on target hardware. You’ll bring hands-on embedded Linux experience and an active interest in networking. Maybe you’ve implemented or debugged a routing protocol, contributed to a networking stack, or built a home lab to experiment with routing and trace where packets get dropped. Experience with routing software or programmable packet processing is a plus, and we welcome experience across networking stacks.

jobs.title: FPGA Digital Design Engineer
jobs.description_text: We’re on the hunt for a top-tier FPGA Digital Design Engineer to develop the next generation of our satellites. At Kepler, you’ll have the opportunity to work with a dedicated team of engineers building the Kepler spacecraft. You will be responsible for the design and implementation of FPGA code either with a focus on DSP algorithms to modulate and demodulate signals on board our software defined radio (SDR), or embedded systems interfacing with processors and peripherals. To be effective you will need to participate in all phases of FPGA design flow (Simulation, Synthesis, Place & Route, Timing Closure and Hardware Testing). A good understanding of the intricacies of FPGA development would make a candidate standout.

jobs.title: Lead (Chief) Satellite Systems Engineer (Contingent)

You will translate program objectives into executable technical plans, aligning requirements, architecture, interfaces, trade studies, verification evidence, and risk decisions across a large cross-functional team. The ideal candidate has demonstrated experience delivering through at least one satellite-level program lifecycle. Experience with constellation-level architectures, multi-satellite delivery, or cross-program technical execution is a strong asset. This role requires strong systems engineering judgment, the ability to lead through ambiguity, and the communication discipline to align teams and stakeholders while balancing technical integrity with cost, schedule, risk, mission assurance, and customer expectations. This position is intended for a technical leader who can operate with credibility across engineering, program management, product assurance, suppliers, customers, and senior leadership. T1/T2 expectations emphasize ownership of technical outcomes, disciplined integration, requirements alignment, decision closure, readiness evidence, and system-wide integration readiness across multiple subsystems.

In this role, you will lead the design and development of complex spacecraft electronics, provide technical guidance and mentorship to other engineers, and help ensure hardware is delivered to the required standards of performance, reliability, and quality. You will work closely with cross-functional engineering teams, including RF, mechanical, software, FPGA and systems engineering, to develop and integrate hardware solutions for current and future satellite platforms and customer missions.

The successful engineer understands the full signal chain, from photons to bits, and can engage the engineers and suppliers responsible for each key element of the payload. The role focuses on VNIR as well as cooled and uncooled infrared payloads that balance mission performance and product requirements against cost, schedule, and SWaP, and collaborates across Sales & Product, Satellite Systems Engineering, Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering & Perception, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Test Engineering.

jobs.title: Plumber (West Midlands)
jobs.description_text: Help us make a big green dent in the universe. We're on a mission to drive the global renewable energy revolution and need your help to turn our vision into a reality. As part of the Octopus Energy Services crew, you’ll be working closely with our office based teams to get our innovative renewable products installed into customer homes. You’ll have the backing of Octopus Energy’s massive tech power to minimise admin, so you can focus on delivering top-class service to our customers. We're looking for plumbers who have experience in heating systems and are passionate about providing our customers with the best service possible (we’ll provide full training to help you transition over to renewables). You'll be the face of Octopus Energy in our customers' homes backed by a strong track record of safety, respect and top-tier service, you’ll love connecting with customers just as much as handling the technical work.

jobs.description_text: What we do. Electric Car Leasing Why we do it. Greener. Fairer. Future. We are looking for a talented Product Designer with a versatile skillset to join our team. In this role, you’ll play a key part in crafting exceptional customer experiences, balancing user needs with business goals without sacrificing quality. We’re looking for a team player with a curious, self-driven mindset, who thrives in a fast-paced iterative environment with a high level of autonomy. This role will be highly collaborative. You’ll work closely with fellow designers, developers, product managers and stakeholders to identify opportunities for improvement, and proactively deliver solutions. You will care about the whole customer experience, not only the UI.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description_text: What we do. Electric Car Leasing Why we do it. Greener. Fairer. Future. We are looking for a super collaborative Product Manager to join our London team, to help grow one of Octopus Energy Group’s most exciting businesses and accelerate the driving public on their energy transition. We are building a whole new way for drivers to join the electric revolution. Not only can they learn about and shop for their EV online, but also experience a ‘lease for life’ through an industry-changing customer experience. The Product team is crucial in defining and bringing to market this vision while working hand in hand with all teams across the company to deliver it in record time.

jobs.title: Production Operative - Assembly
jobs.description_text: As part of our commitment to renewable energy, we are expanding our operations in Portadown and seeking a Production Operative to join our growing factory team. If you're passionate about renewable energy and want to make a positive impact on the world, this is the role for you! As a Production Operative, you will play a vital role in the manufacturing process of our innovative heat pumps. You will be at the forefront of creating cutting-edge technology that helps homes and businesses reduce their carbon footprint while keeping them warm and cosy. With a strong attention to detail and working within a wider team, you will ensure that our heat pumps are produced to the highest quality standards.

jobs.title: Renewals Expert
jobs.description_text: What we do. Electric Car Leasing Why we do it. Greener. Fairer. Future. You will be joining our newly established Driver Success Team, a dedicated team responsible for maximising customer retention and satisfaction at the end of their lease agreement. Existing customers are not 'new leads'; they require a strategic, relationship-based approach, not a standard sales call. Your goal will be to convert upcoming lease renewals, win back 'controllable' leavers, and renew relationships by resolving issues directly, ensuring a great experience that encourages drivers to stay. This is a hybrid role, with 3 days per week based in our Weybridge office.

jobs.title: Senior Financial Accountant H/F
jobs.description_text: Tu as envie de travailler dans un environnement bienveillant qui avance vite ? 5ème fournisseur français en 10 ans, Octopus Energy est un fournisseur d’énergies renouvelables qui agit comme un véritable fer de lance pour la révolution électro tech. Comment on fait ? On ne peut pas révolutionner le monde en travaillant comme tout le monde On essaye de ne pas trop se prendre la tête, ici on évolue dans un environnement sans trop de process ni trop de règles. Le plus important, ce n’est pas seulement de suivre le mouvement, mais de le créer. On ne veut pas créer des clones d’entreprise. On te veut toi, avec tes talents, tes perspectives et tes compétences uniques. Pourquoi ce poste ? Octopus Energy France connaît une forte croissance sur ses segments B2C, B2B et B2G, et sa fonction Finance se structure en parallèle : migration récente d’Odoo vers NetSuite, automatisation de la chaîne fournisseurs, interfaçage avec les plateformes de facturation, harmonisation avec les standards du groupe au Royaume-Uni. Nous cherchons un·e Senior Financial Accountant (comptable senior) capable de prendre en main un périmètre critique (marge brute et fiscalité énergie), de le fiabiliser et de le faire évoluer. Plus qu’un·e exécutant·e, tu seras celui ou celle qui identifie les problèmes, en comprend la cause et met en place des solutions durables.

This role sits at the heart of our quantitative research practice, ensuring the rigor, accuracy, and reliability of our data. jobs.description_text: Reporting directly to the Divisional Sales Director, the Regional Vice President (VP) is responsible for providing external wholesaling support to a select group of distributors, with a primary focus on the wire house and Independent Broker Dealer market. The Regional VP will be held accountable for achieving aggressive premium growth targets within their designated territory. Additionally, this role entails comprehensive management of all aspects of the carrier and distributor relationship, including sales, marketing, pending case advocacy, and other related responsibilities. The position requires substantial overnight travel, with a minimum expectation of 50%, and significant virtual engagement with distributors. This position is responsible for managing specific accounts across the following states: Alabama (AL), Arkansas (AR), Florida (FL), Louisiana (LA), Mississippi (MS), Puerto Rico (PR), and Texas (TX). Candidate must live in the territory. Qualifications Minimum Requirements Superior sales abilities and strong relationship-building capabilities. Three to five years of internal or external life insurance wholesaling experience at the carrier level, preferably within a broker dealer or wire house environment. Successful point-of-sale experience is highly desirable. Extensive understanding of life insurance products, associated sales concepts, and case design. Sound technical literacy, including a basic understanding of illustration software, Excel, and PowerPoint. Expe

jobs.title: Sales & Service Representative
jobs.description_text: The Sr Internal Wholesaler works within the sales organization, partnering with External Wholesaler(s) in geographical sales territories. This individual is responsible for partnering with an External Wholesaler, creating new and managing existing relationships with representatives to increase revenue of Protective products and achieve territory sales goals. This role is primarily focused on servicing representatives through phone and email communication. This position requires an individual that has a strong sales-focused approach with professional communication skills, hard work ethic, and a competitive drive to succeed. The base salary range for this position is $60,000 to $75,000 annually. Actual compensation will be determined based on a variety of factors, including, but not limited to, geographic location, skills, and experience. This position is also eligible to participate in Protective's Sales Incentive Plan (SIP). Target annual sales incentive compensation is currently estimated to range from $40,000 to $50,000 depending on individual performance and applicable plan terms.

jobs.title: Sales Associate - Asset Protection - Direct Channel
jobs.description_text: The Sales Associate supports sales growth and dealership relationships within an assigned territory or portfolio in Protective’s Direct Channel. Reporting to the Sales Lead, this role advances sales opportunities through proactive outreach, consultative discovery, product presentations, follow-up, and coordination of onboarding and account-support activities. The Sales Associate maintains accurate customer and opportunity information, follows established sales processes, and builds knowledge of Protective’s products, dealership operations, and F&I sales practices. The role manages moderately complex accounts and opportunities with guidance as needed and partners with Senior Sales Associates, New Account Acquisition, Product, Underwriting, Marketing, Operations, Sales Operations, and Sales Enablement to deliver a responsive dealer experience and contribute to profitable growth and retention. Responsibilities Achieves assigned sales, activity, product penetration, and account-support objectives across an assigned territory or portfolio of dealership accounts Develops and maintains a pipeline of qualified leads and opportunities through proactive outreach, follow-up, referrals, campaigns, and other sales activities Builds productive relationships with dealership owners, F&I leaders, and other customer contacts to understand needs, support retention, and identify growth opportunities Conducts sales discovery to understand dealership priorities, customer needs, operating practices

jobs.title: Senior Director - Portfolio Risk & Underwriting Strategy
jobs.description_text: Help shape the profitability and risk strategy of a growing, multi-product Asset Protection portfolio. Protective is seeking a senior insurance leader who can connect underwriting judgment with actuarial analysis, pricing, forecasting, and portfolio performance management. This high-visibility role will influence decisions across vehicle protection plans, GAP coverage, limited warranties, and ancillary products serving automotive, marine, powersports, and recreational vehicle markets. You will lead underwriting strategy and governance, turn complex portfolio data into clear actions, and advise executive leaders on growth, profitability, and risk. This opportunity is well suited to a P&C actuarial or underwriting leader who enjoys moving beyond analysis to shape products, risk appetite, operating practices, and business outcomes. You will also build organizational capability by developing talent and strengthening the tools and processes used to manage the portfolio. Protective’s targeted salary range for this position is $137,000 to $210,000. The internal title for this position is "Sr. Director Underwriting".

Additional responsibilities include designing and developing new applications and automations as well as extending and supporting existing solutions using the Power Platform including any of the following: Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Virtual Agents, Dataverse, Power FX, Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Azure API Management Gateway, PCF Controls, and SQL Server. They will require a high level of experience understanding business problems and coding technically sound solutions following industry best practices while exhibiting the ability to communicate in both a technical and non-technical or business manner, depending on the audience. jobs.title: Director of Field Marketing
jobs.description_text: About the role As Director of Field Marketing at Quandri reporting to the CMO, you’ll establish the strategy, operating rhythms, and measurement needed to generate demand for Quandri’s software in our first priority regions. As the program grows, you’ll hire and lead marketers dedicated to individual regions. You’ll work closely with regional Sales teams to understand their markets, target accounts, and pipeline goals. You’ll turn those priorities into a focused mix of hosted events, sponsored conferences, executive dinners, meetups, local digital programs, and other tactics you think are relevant and meaningful. The industry is insurance, and the events are fun: think golf tournaments, baseball games, community get-togethers and more. This is a hands-on role: you’ll set the direction and personally deliver programs while building the team. You will: Build the field marketing plan for Quandri’s first defined regions, deciding where to invest and developing repeatable programs that can scale. Manage field events from start to finish, including venues, vendors, staffing, on-site materials, and execution. For each major event, agree with Sales on the accounts to reach, meetings to book, and opportunities to advance. Plan outreach before the event, secure clear next steps during it, and ensure timely, personalized follow-up is recorded in HubSpot. Set goals for meetings, qualified opportunities, and sourced and influenced pipeline. Report results and use them to refine the plan.

jobs.title: Director of Product Marketing
jobs.description_text: We’ve built a platform that is reshaping how insurance agencies operate. As Quandri expands across workflows, pricing tiers, and customer segments, product marketing will play a central role in helping buyers understand what the platform can do and why it matters. About the role We’re looking for a Director of Product Marketing to lead how Quandri positions its platform, brings new capabilities to market, and equips our teams to win. You’ll develop a deep understanding of insurance agencies, their buying decisions, and the work our software changes. You’ll turn those insights into clear messaging that connects product capabilities to business outcomes. Reporting to the CMO, you’ll lead the function with a hands-on mandate. You’ll establish the frameworks and operating rhythms for product marketing while writing, launching, testing, and refining the work yourself. As the company grows, you’ll help build the team to support an expanding product portfolio. You will: Lead positioning and messaging for Quandri’s platform in partnership with the CMO. Make its value clear across workflows, buyer groups, markets, and pricing tiers while keeping the overall story coherent. Build a regular practice of customer and prospect research. Use interviews, win/loss analysis, Sales feedback, and product data to understand buying decisions and test the assumptions behind our go-to-market plans. Set priorities for product launches. Decide which releases warrant a coordinated market launch, which

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, AI Operations
jobs.description_text: About the Role You will help reinvent how Quandri's teams operate by combining a deep understanding of their work with practical knowledge of what AI can do. We are looking for a systems thinker and hands-on builder who actively experiments with foundation models, agents, and emerging tools, recognizes when new capabilities make a different approach possible, and turns that insight into solutions people will use. You will own two connected responsibilities: Quandri's internal AI platform and company-wide adoption. The platform will include shared tools, agent infrastructure, evaluation, and guardrails. Adoption means working with functional leaders to redesign workflows, build team capabilities, and make new ways of working effective and sustainable. Your customers are our teams across Sales, Marketing, Customer Experience, Implementation, Finance, Operations, Product and Engineering. You will discover where work gets stuck, decide which problems are worth solving, and take solutions from prototype to sustained use. You will report to the VP of Product and partner closely with Engineering, the VP of Finance and Operations, Security, and functional leaders. You should already use AI extensively in your own work and have a clear point of view, grounded in experimentation, on where it is useful and where it falls short. Your success here will show up in sustained, high-quality adoption, faster work, better decisions, and capacity returned to teams. You will also help colleagues

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Canada
jobs.description_text: About the Role: Canadian brokerages have been with Quandri from the start, and are a core part of our business. We're doubling down on Canada and hiring a Product Manager to lead it. Think of this role as the CEO of Quandri Canada from a product perspective. You’ll own the Canadian market across our entire product portfolio, including Quoting, Analyze, Intelligence and our shared platform. You’ll be accountable for understanding what Canadian customers need, deciding where we invest, and showing the return on that investment. You’ll deliver through our existing product and engineering teams rather than a dedicated team, so your ability to build a compelling case and influence without authority will be key. This is a rare chance to own a market, with a high level of scope and impact. What you’ll do: Own the success of the Canadian market across Quandri’s product portfolio, including the return on what we invest in Canada. Meet our Canadian customers to understand the state of the market, their workflows, and where our product falls short. Build and own our investment strategy in the Canadian market: the most important unmet needs, a prioritized set of investments, and the resources and outcomes tied to each. Make the case for your priorities: present and justify your approach to leadership stakeholders. You’ll own customer issues from the first report through resolution. That means investigating, troubleshooting and diagnosing problems across a technically complex product, then explaining the fix clearly and with empathy. You’ll work closely with Customer Success, Implementation, Product and Engineering. You’ll turn what customers tell you into clear bug reports, product feedback and escalations. Beyond the ticket queue, you’ll keep an eye on our customers’ system runs so you can catch problems before customers do, write Knowledge Hub articles that help brokerages solve issues on their own, and dig into ticket data to find patterns that make support faster and smarter. You’ll also support incident management, including determining severity, streamline communications, and working with other cross-functional teams like Product and Engineering to resolve the issue. This is a hands-on role on a small, growing team, so you’ll have real ownership and a direct hand in how support works at Quandri. What you’ll do: Provide prompt and professional responses to customer inquiries ensuring the delivery of high-quality and timely support. Utilize AI technology to scale ticket support and responses, optimizing the technology to ensure quick and accurate responses to our customers. Oversee the ticket management process, including establishing timeli

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist - Germany Forward Deployed
jobs.description_text: NOTE: Although this position is in support of our US Government work, this role is located in Wiesbaden, Germany. What We're About At its core, the Deployment Strategist role centers around leveraging data in operational and real-world action. Our customers come to us with a hunch that the only way to protect their troops, manufacture high-quality products, structure effective healthcare policies, or deliver aid to refugees safely is to make better use of their data. Deployment Strategists are responsible for turning that hunch into reality. If you believe in the transformational power of data and technology and in your own ability to bring that power to bear against complex problems, we want to meet you. What We Do As a Deployment Strategist, you'll work as part of a driven and creative team of Engineers, Product Designers, and other Deployment Strategists to deploy software against the most challenging problems our world faces. Your mission is to synthesize disconnected streams of thought into a cohesive understanding of what the most important problem is, what the data means, what the product needs, what users are motivated by, and where the impact could be. Deployment Strategists are do-ers who immerse themselves in our customers' most intricate workflows, partner with customer teams and explore the data, and dive into the product landscape to enable us to scale. A select number of Deployments Strategists may also be deployed to Palantir internal teams and problems. In th

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer - Germany Forward Deployed
jobs.description_text: NOTE: Although this position is in support of our US Government work, this role is located in Wiesbaden, Germany. The Role Forward Deployed Software Engineers (FDSEs) work directly with customers to quickly understand their greatest problems and design and implement solutions to use data against them. Our customers rely on Palantir’s platforms for some of their most critical operations, and projects often start with an open ended question like “Why are we delaying so many flights?” or “How can we better identify instances of money laundering?” As an FDSE, you’ll apply your problem solving ability, creativity, and technical skills to help organizations use their data to drive a real impact in the world. You’ll have the opportunity to gain rare insight into and contribute to some of the world’s most important industries and institutions. As an FDSE your responsibilities look similar to those of a startup CTO: you’ll work in small teams with minimal supervision and own end-to-end execution of high stakes projects. Your day might span discussing architecture with fellow engineers, wrangling massive-scale data, coding a custom web app, speaking with customer executives, or establishing strategy for your team. Whether you aspire to be an entrepreneur or an engineering leader, we believe Palantir is the best place — with the best colleagues — to learn how. You’ll learn how to unpack a problem and understand the costs and consequences of its solution. You’ll learn new technologies an

jobs.title: Information Security Engineer - Infrastructure Security
jobs.location_raw: London, United Kingdom · New York, NY · Washington, D.C.
jobs.description_text: The Role We're looking for an Information Security Engineer who can think broadly about how infrastructure is built, attacked, defended, and improved. You may have deep experience in one area—such as endpoint security, Active Directory, Data Loss Prevention, cloud security, identity, or detection and response—but you’re motivated by solving security problems across the environment. As an Information Security Engineer focused on infrastructure security, you'll help protect Palantir's global endpoints, servers, identity systems, applications, networks, and data flows. You'll work across teams to reduce attack surface, improve defensive controls, investigate security events, and turn security findings into durable architectural and operational improvements. This is not just a corporate security role; the adversaries we face are sophisticated. We need someone who understands both the details and the broader system: how a weakness in one part of the environment can create risk somewhere else, how controls interact, and how to build security improvements that hold up in practice.

jobs.title: Intellectual Property Counsel
jobs.location_raw: London, United Kingdom · Denver, CO · New York, NY · Palo Alto, CA · Washington, D.C.
jobs.description_text: The Role Palantir's in-house legal team works to proactively address legal issues so that Palantir can continue to drive positive impact in the world. Our IP Counsel are the legal backbone of Palantir's intellectual property strategy across all domains: patents, trademark, copyright, and trade secret. In this role you'll become a go-to advisor on the protection of Palantir's cutting edge technology. You'll have the opportunity to work on a wide array of intellectual property matters, including patent harvesting, portfolio development, and landscaping, trademark strategy and management, licensing and partnership agreements, open source strategy and compliance, product development issues, and strategic advice for product and business teams. Our ideal candidate has strong technical and interpersonal skills, meaning you are comfortable working with a variety of stakeholders from software developers and internal business teams, to third parties. You're able to maintain focus on the details and can take on novel, complex issues as they arise, whilst also holding the ownership and sense of responsibility needed to bring large and multi-stepped projects to completion. Although focused on intellectual property, as a member of the legal team you're excited to work on the broad range of projects that arise at a fast-paced, dynamic company.

jobs.title: Operations Analyst - US Government Security
jobs.description_text: The Role As an Operations Analyst supporting our US Government teams, you keep the mission moving by tracking and stabilizing projects, removing roadblocks, owning operational outcomes, and staying two steps ahead so the team can focus on what they do best. This role demands a varying range of responsibilities; you could be managing a classified facility and vendors one hour and scoping process improvement initiatives the next. You're a first-responder by instinct, a systems thinker by habit, someone who finds order in ambiguity, sees friction as a problem worth solving and shows up everyday with a Get Things Done mentality. Communication and attention to detail are core to how you operate, not afterthoughts. You'll be part of a high-accountability, high-expectation team that is just as invested in each other's success as they are in Palantir's mission. Feedback isn't just welcomed here, it's how we get better.

jobs.title: Site Reliability Operations Analyst - Legal
jobs.description_text: A World-Changing Company Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Applied AI, Defense Applications
jobs.description_text: The Role Palantir's Defense Applied AI product team builds products that help the modern warfighter leverage AI for their most mission-critical work. You will help own the entire end to end Agent experience in our products and work relentlessly to ensure they deliver value for our users, while maintaining a high bar for quality. Your day-to-day workflow will vary, adapting to the requirements of our users and the technical challenges that arise. One day, you may find yourself collaborating with users to refine the UX of a particular workflow, the next you could be fine-tuning performance to enable low-latency or more accurate operational outcomes. Our Product Development organization is made up of small teams of Software Engineers. Each team focuses on a specific aspect of a product and work collaboratively to build cross functional capabilities, streamline user workflows and continuously improve our software's efficiency and reliability. We’re hiring engineers who are passionate about solving real-world problems and empowering both developers and end-users to work optimally. If you’re motivated to develop reliable, performant, and scalable AI products, this role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact on our products and the people who use them.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Internship - Query Engines
jobs.location_raw: London, United Kingdom · New York, NY
jobs.description_text: The Role We are a software engineering team applying open-source data technologies to some of the world's hardest and most important problems. We build the data processing infrastructure that underpins Palantir Foundry, supporting applications that help hospitals care for more patients, help clinical teams coordinate timely diagnoses, and keep essential supplies moving through global disruption. You will work deep inside the systems that make this possible: how computations are represented, how query plans are optimised, how operators execute, and how data is read and written efficiently. We build on and extend Apache Spark, Apache DataFusion, and Apache Iceberg, bringing advances in open-source engines and table formats into the demanding environments our customers operate in. Our work serves many products and workloads across Foundry, including no-code pipelines, interactive analysis, and the processing that keeps the Ontology up to date. Working alongside experienced engineers, you will take on real problems in our production systems. That could mean writing a new planning rule, adding a capability to a native execution engine, or making large tables faster to scan. You will see your work through design, code review, testing, and release. Correctness, compatibility, and predictable performance are central to everything we build, and you will learn how to deliver all three. We are looking for interns with strong coding fundamentals and experience with AI systems. Our mission is to advance the Boston Red Sox in pursuit of World Championships through a comprehensive and collaborative player development system. Our approach involves the creation of world-class player programs and efficiently scaling them across our player pool. Collaborating closely with other departments, we establish effective frameworks for exploration, learning, and development. Additionally, we work closely with Amateur Scouting, International Scouting, and Pro Scouting to ensure seamless player transitions into the Red Sox organization. Simply put, we strive to be the standard in player and staff development. Reporting to the Director, Research & Development, Defence Satellite Mission Solutions, you will independently deliver engineering investigations from mission-need qualification through laboratory validation at Technology Readiness Level 4 (TRL 4), within agreed objectives, scope and decision criteria. Initial opportunities include alternative positioning, navigation and timing (PNT), optical relay connectivity with other satellite systems, and space-domain awareness data products. You will apply broad engineering experience, curiosity and sound judgement across disciplines and unfamiliar technologies.

jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com The opportunity Build and scale a highly capable System Engineering Delivery team within the Lightspeed Systems Engineering division, alongside Telesat’s established LEO System Engineering (LEO SE) team. This opportunity is for a high-energy leader who enjoys developing strong managers and engineers, expanding capacity for complex work, and turning demanding technical objectives into disciplined delivery. As Director, System Engineering Delivery, you will establish and lead a department that will support the consolidation of the Lightspeed technical baseline by delivering complete engineering packages for assigned system portfolios. Your department will also build and maintain shared engineering software tools, including AI tools, to improve engineering throughput, quality and efficiency across the division. Working in partnership with LEO SE and segment teams, your department will complement LEO SE’s continuing engineering work by adding scalable delivery capacity and reusable engineering capabilities across the division. Why this role Build a lasting engineering capability while delivering meaningful technical outcomes on Lightspeed. You will have scope to develop leaders, connect Systems Engineering and software disciplines, and introduce tools that teams use in their everyday engineering work. This role suits a high-energy leader who builds momentum, drives results and thrives in a demanding,

jobs.title: Lead Mil-Ka Senior System Engineering Specialist
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com Within the System Engineering team, lead the technical coordination needed to adapt Lightspeed’s low Earth orbit constellation and associated ground infrastructure for military Ka-band communications supporting the Enhanced Satellite Communications Project - Polar (ESCP-P) and other defence customers. This is a senior individual-contributor role in which you will lead technical work across all Lightspeed teams without managing staff. You will build on established designs, analyses, and test plans, focusing additional analysis where decisions require it. ESCP-P is intended to meet Government of Canada requirements by providing the Canadian Armed Forces (CAF) with secure, resilient, high-speed communications for operations at home and abroad, particularly in Arctic and other high-latitude regions. The project supports Canada’s Arctic sovereignty and continental defence, including interoperability with the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) and North American Aerospace Defense Command (NORAD).

The role is primarily oriented toward instructional design, content development, and learner experience. Working with Sales Operations, subject matter experts, and cross-functional partners, the Specialist creates clear, engaging, and scalable learning experiences that support employee success. These solutions help employees confidently adopt and apply Sales Operations systems, capabilities, and business processes, improving adoption, knowledge retention, and performance. The ideal candidate brings 3-5 years of relevant experience, strong instructional design and content-development capabilities, and the ability to independently own work from concept through delivery. AI, automation, and emerging technologies are expected to be integral to how the role develops content, improves workflows, and increases operational efficiency.

jobs.title: Senior Account Executive, Mexico & Central America
jobs.description_text: Telesat (Nasdaq and TSX: TSAT) is a leading global satellite operator, providing reliable and secure satellite-delivered communications solutions worldwide to broadcast, telecommunications, corporate and government customers for over 55 years. Backed by a legacy of engineering excellence, reliability and industry-leading customer service, Telesat has grown to be one of the largest and most successful global satellite operators. Telesat Lightspeed, our revolutionary Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite network, scheduled to begin service in 2027, will revolutionize global broadband connectivity for enterprise and Government users by delivering a combination of high capacity, security, resiliency and affordability with ultra-low latency and fiber-like speeds. Telesat is headquartered in Ottawa, Canada, and has offices and facilities around the world. The company’s state-of-the-art Satellite fleet consists of 12 GEO satellites, the Canadian payload on ViaSat-1 and one LEO 3 demonstration satellite. For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com

jobs.title: Senior Defence Systems Engineering Specialist
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com Are you passionate about breakthrough technologies and eager to shape the future of satellite-based solutions for defence and national security? We are seeking a Senior Defence Systems Engineering Specialist to help shape new satellite-enabled capabilities for Canadian and allied defence users. Reporting to the Director, Research & Development, Defence Satellite Mission Solutions, you will lead multidisciplinary investigations from mission-need qualification through initial prototype laboratory validation. Initial opportunities include system features such as alternative positioning, navigation and timing (PNT), optical relay connectivity with other satellite systems, and space-domain awareness data products. You will combine technical depth with systems thinking, practical experimentation and multidisciplinary leadership.

jobs.title: Senior DevSecOps Developer
jobs.department: Lightspeed System Development - Landing Stations and User Terminals
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com We are seeking a Senior DevSecOps Developer to help build and operate secure embedded and cloud-native software delivery environments. This role will provide technical leadership for the implementation and integration of security capabilities within CI/CD pipelines, including static application security testing (SAST), dynamic application security testing (DAST), software composition analysis (SCA), software supply-chain security, vulnerability management, artifact integrity, and code signing. Working within the Engineering DevSecOps team and closely with the CI/CD Architecture Lead, the Senior DevSecOps Security Engineer will partner with development teams to embed security controls into engineering workflows, strengthen secure development practices, and support the remediation of vulnerabilities identified through automated tooling. The role will also collaborate closely with Telesat Cybersecurity and Compliance teams to translate security policies, standards, and control requirements into practical, automated engineering controls.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager

This role is accountable for integrated planning, supplier execution, cross-functional and technical alignment, acceptance, deployment, and operational readiness. Combining strong program leadership with telecommunications/SATCOM knowledge, the Senior Program Manager works across engineering, System Architecture, Product Owners, Integration and Test, program controls, Procurement, Operations, and external suppliers to manage dependencies, risks, commitments, and critical decisions. The role may establish a new program or take ownership of an in-flight delivery, quickly building a fact-based view of status, priorities, critical path, supplier commitments, and recovery needs. Success requires strong supplier and stakeholder leadership, commercial and contractual awareness, and a delivery-focused approach that drives issues and decisions to closure.

In addition to hands-on development, you will mentor engineers, coordinate testing activities, and help drive automation best practices across the team.

jobs.title: Senior Spectrum Engineer
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com The incumbent is responsible for securing, maintaining, and protecting the spectrum and orbital rights required to support Telesat's GSO and NGSO satellite systems. The role leads complex spectrum engineering, ITU filing and coordination activities; conducts interference and compatibility analyses; supports satellite system design from a spectrum and regulatory perspective; and represents Telesat in technical coordination discussions with satellite operators, administrations, and relevant domestic and international regulatory bodies. The position provides technical and regulatory advice that informs satellite system design, spectrum strategy, and regulatory decisions.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Writer
jobs.department: Lightspeed System Development - Landing Stations and User Terminals
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com The Senior Technical Writer is responsible for developing, maintaining, and improving Engineering Design Documentation across the Lightspeed program. This role serves as the central documentation authority for component-level architecture and design knowledge, ensuring that engineering teams have access to accurate, consistent, and maintainable technical documentation. The role supports the development of both High Level Design (HLD) and Detailed Design Description (DDD) documentation for key Engineering Segment components such as On-Board Processor Software Systems, User Terminals (UTs) Systems, LS LS-BB and ACU Systems The successful candidate works closely with System Architects, Software Architects, Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), Developers, Integration Teams, and Product Owners to transform existing engineering knowledge into structured, maintainable design documentation. The documentation produced complements existing Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), Interface Control Documents (ICDs), Technical Requirement Documents (TRDs), Architecture Reviews, Confluence content, Implementation repositories Capella (MBSE) content and acts as the authoritative engineering knowledge repository for internal engineering teams.
